optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Customer Support Team Lead, Help Desk Software
professionalSummary: Team lead for a tier‑one support team of seven agents at a software company for two years, responsible for shift rota, queue assignments, coaching, escalation and reporting.
experienceHighlights: Set weekly shift rota and queue assignments using the workforce tool.
Coached agents on ticket handling against the company’s quality rubric and ran the weekly quality review, recording coaching notes in agents’ files.
Escalated tier‑two issues through the escalation queue, documenting ownership of checks.
Reported team response and resolution metrics to the support manager each week from the ticketing system dashboard.
Managed hiring, pay and disciplinary matters through the support manager, focusing on rota, coaching, escalation and reporting.
projectsAndWorkSamples: One month’s shift rotas, one weekly quality review record with coaching notes, and four weekly metrics reports, with ticketing system and workforce tool references as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s responsibilities and activities in shift management, coaching, escalation, and reporting, but do not provide evidence of documentation of hand‑over conditions or open issues for the support manager.
